visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Fluid width instead of a fixed one
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The image has a fixed width of 600px, which is wider than a phone. Make it fluid with width 100% and a max-width of 600px. It must never be wider than 600px.

solution.explanation: A fixed 600px width overflows a 320px screen. width: 100% with max-width: 600px shrinks on small screens and stops growing at 600px.

checks.label: The hero is never wider than 600px
On a wide screen the hero is 600px
